note: Bucket sizes are not published and must be read from X-RateLimit-Limit at runtime. Discord explicitly advises against hardcoding limits.

global.scope: per bot token; per IP if unauthenticated
global.raise_on_request: support can raise it for bots that repeatedly trip it in legitimate operation

per_route.major_parameter_effect: same route on two different channel_ids is two independent limits
per_route.shared_buckets: routes returning the same X-RateLimit-Bucket string share one limit
per_route.emoji_routes: limited per guild; headers do not follow normal conventions and returned quota may be inaccurate

headers.X-RateLimit-Scope: present only on 429: user | global | shared

body.message: The resource is being rate limited.

429_shared.note: explicitly exempt from the invalid-request threshold

errors.optional_code_field: appears for resource-specific limits, e.g. 20016 slowmode

retry_after_fields.recommendation: prefer the body field for precision; header loses sub-second accuracy

invalid_request_limit.consequence: temporary Cloudflare IP ban (~10 min); responses become HTML error 1015 instead of JSON
common_causes: unhandled 429 retried in a tight loop

retry_guidance.primary_fix: track invalid-request budget and stop before 10,000; per-bucket queue for normal pacing
retry_guidance.bucket_map: cache X-RateLimit-Bucket -> X-RateLimit-Reset-After on every response
retry_guidance.route_key: use the real METHOD path with real IDs; major parameters split buckets

escape_hatch: treat the X-RateLimit-Bucket header as the definition of the ceiling: a single request per route converts an unpublished limit into a locally known one
